title: 1934 plot to overthrow FDR via General Smedley Butler

tellings.quote: they they tried to recruit the commandant of the United States Marine Corps General Butler to lead a major Insurrection of the of the World War II veterans you know against Franklin Roosevelt's government

plain: In 1934, according to a guest named Dan Sheehan, a group tried to recruit General Smedley Butler, a former commandant of the US Marine Corps, to lead an uprising of war veterans against President Franklin Roosevelt's government. Sheehan passes it on as something he was told. If it were true, it would mean a plot to overthrow an American president from inside the country.
